data.title: Keeping Things Cool
data.description: Come help us build cozy shade to see what happens when the bright sun shines down!

challenges.instruction: The snowman is out on the sunny sand. Build something to keep it cool all day, so the red line stays below the blue cool line. Then move the sun across the sky.
